script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: second chances

Begin screenplay.

Title: THE RESTART PROJECT

FADE IN:

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY

A bustling open-plan office filled with computer whizzes in T-shirts and jeans, heads down, typing away at their keyboards.

At the center, two middle-aged employees, PETER (nerdy, introverted) and MARIA (confident, outgoing), sit at their desks, separated by a glass partition. They exchange polite smiles.

INT. TECH COMPANY - KITCHEN - LATER

Peter pours himself a cup of coffee. Maria enters, wearing a bright red blouse.

MARIA
Morning, Peter.

PETER
(stammering)
Morning, Maria.

They share an awkward silence. Maria notices his red eyes.

MARIA
Long night?

PETER
(shaking his head)
No, just... tired.

MARIA
Well, I've got a new energy bar that might help you out. It's organic and packed with superfoods.

She hands him the bar. He looks surprised but grateful.

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY - SEVEN DAYS LATER

Peter and Maria's desks are now next to each other. They exchange smiles as they work.

INT. TECH COMPANY - KITCHEN - ONE WEEK LATER

Peter and Maria sit at a table, eating lunch.

MARIA
I've noticed you've been looking tired lately. What's going on?

PETER
(sighs)
My wife left me six months ago. It's been tough, you know?

MARIA
(puts a comforting hand on his arm)
I'm so sorry, Peter. But things can get better.

PETER
(sadly)
I doubt it. I've lost my spark, my motivation. I don't know how to get it back.

MARIA
(excitedly)
Well, I might have an idea. Have you ever heard of the Restart Project?

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY - THE FOLLOWING DAY

Peter and Maria meet with the company's HR representative, LUCY (efficient, empathetic).

LUCY
The Restart Project is a company-sponsored initiative designed to help employees regain their work-life balance and motivation. We've seen tremendous success stories.

PETER
(skeptically)
What does it involve?

LUCY
It's flexible. It could be anything from a career change within the company, taking on a new project, or even a sabbatical. We'll work together to find what suits you best.

PETER
(incredulously)
Really? I'd never thought that was an option for me.

LUCY
(smiling)
It's amazing what you can accomplish when you're given a second chance.

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY - TWO WEEKS LATER

Peter is now working on an exciting new project, and his spirit has been rejuvenated. He and Maria share a moment of pride.

INT. TECH COMPANY - DAY - SIX WEEKS LATER

Peter and Maria sit at the kitchen table, smiling at each other.

MARIA
I've never seen you look so alive, Peter.

PETER
(gratefully)
Thank you, Maria. It's all thanks to you and the Restart Project.

MARIA
(smiling)
You're welcome. I'm just glad to see you smiling again.

FADE OUT.

THE END
